slides.headline: An ETF is one share that holds [hundreds of stocks]

slides.title: How it works
paras: A fund buys a basket of assets. You buy one share of the fund on the stock exchange, <g>like any stock</g>.

slides.title: ETF vs other choices
paras: The big pluses: <g>spread out</g> risk, low fees, and you can buy or sell any time the market is open.

slides.title: From stocks to Bitcoin
paras: ETFs now hold gold and crypto too. Not financial advice.

items.t: First US ETF: SPY, the S&P 500
